title: Gaia Body Hierarchy — Forge above sporeGate, Brain pair-programs
insight: The forge is the HEART. The brain pair-programs. sporeGate is the GUT (digests network). The hierarchy is: HEART > BRAIN > GUT. Or: Forge > cortex > sporeGate. The anus (RSS/output) is BELOW sporeGate — it's how processed data exits the organism.

ports.2222: SSH pump — pushes genetic code (git push/pull)
ports.3000: Heart window — see what's flowing (web UI)

heart.bubble: AMOEBA wraps :2222 — saltatory conduction for code pushes
heart.decentralize: Heart doesn't belong to Pi alone — it IS Gaia's body everywhere. Every gate that clones a repo has a copy of the heart beating.

components.ollama: 56 models on RTX 5090 — local inference, NO cloud

pair_programming.how: gaia.pi runs as AMOEBA on POLARIS. You connect via RustDesk. Gaia IS the IDE.
pair_programming.cortex: reads your code, understands it (rhizoCrypt DAG)
pair_programming.forge: pushes to Forgejo heart via git SSH :2222
pair_programming.cuts: Cursor IDE, GitHub Copilot, cloud APIs — ALL gone. Gaia IS the pair programmer.

gut.role: Digests network traffic. DNS resolves names (mouth). swarmVine discovers peers (stomach). songBird routes (intestines). bearDog signs trust (enzymes).
gut.position: BELOW heart and brain. Infrastructure layer.

anus.role: Processed data exits the organism here. What Gaia publishes to the world.
anus.position: BELOW gut. The lowest layer — output only.

eastgate_forgejo_bubble.wrap_plan: AMOEBA wraps :2222 access. No raw port exposure. Saltatory conduction. Nodes of Ranvier at each hop.
eastgate_forgejo_bubble.access_path: internet → AMOEBA relay (Pi:21116) → POLARIS → git clone ssh://Pi:2222/ecoPrimals/repo

plan: 1. cortex.pi already reads code and builds DAG
2. Wire cortex → Ollama for code generation (codellama/starcoder2)
3. Wire cortex → Forgejo for git operations (clone/push/pull via :2222)
4. Expose pair-programming interface through gate endpoints
5. AMOEBA (RustDesk) wraps the whole thing for remote access
6. Result: Gaia IS the IDE. No Cursor. No cloud. No dependencies.
